events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of 'Fawlty Towers', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Python Legend
angles.copy: From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in British history. What's your favourite Cleese classic?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles', but widely known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that was the 'White Album'. Which track from this iconic double LP is on your playlist today?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the death of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: A True Icon
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Join us in celebrating the life and incredible legacy of a true rock icon. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic step forward for the band.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game for pop music. Which track from this masterpiece still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend, John Lennon, who was shot and killed in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, John Lennon's message of peace and love continues to inspire. We remember the incredible artist and activist today. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating The Thin White Duke
angles.copy: A true chameleon of music and style, David Bowie would have turned 80 today. Which era of Bowie's incredible career is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years ago today, a legend was born. We're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are legendary. What's your favourite Pagey moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Eighty-two years young! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. From rock anthems to timeless ballads, what's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His voice defined an era. Which of his classic hits takes you straight back to the 80s?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true force of nature in music and beyond. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us so many hits. What's your all-time favourite Gary Barlow moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! His hits are pure sunshine. What's your favourite track from this legend?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring icons like The Beatles, Bob Dylan, and The Rolling Stones.

angles.name: Who's In Your Hall?
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inducted its first legends. If you could induct any artist today, who would it be and why?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Boyband Charm
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his solo ventures, he's always had that spark. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles took to the roof for their unforgettable final live performance. Imagine being there! What's your favourite moment from that legendary gig?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Up Another Year
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, his music is timeless. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's still bringing the moves and the hits. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Which of his iconic characters holds a special place in your heart?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically lost their lives in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, the music world lost three bright stars. We remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose music continues to live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Him Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! His iconic voice has brought joy across generations. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: The King of Reggae, Bob Marley, would have turned 82 today. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite Bob Marley anthem?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential American singer-songwriter Carole King, known for 'Tapestry' and countless hits, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songwriting shaped generations of music. Which of her timeless tunes is your favourite?
